mapper.select: select a.apply_id, a.apply_no, a.member_id, a.apply_type, a.amount, a.fee, a.actual_amount, a.status, a.account_name, a.account_no, a.bank_name, a.remark, a.audit_by, a.audit_time, a.audit_remark, a.create_time, m.nickname as member_name, m.phone as member_phone, m.balance as member_balance from hys_fund_apply a left join hys_member m on m.member_id = a.member_id where a.apply_id = #{applyId}
mapper.insert: insert into hys_fund_apply (apply_no, member_id, apply_type, amount, fee, actual_amount, status, account_name, account_no, bank_name, remark, create_time) values (#{applyNo}, #{memberId}, #{applyType}, #{amount}, #{fee}, #{actualAmount}, 0, #{accountName}, #{accountNo}, #{bankName}, #{remark}, now())
mapper.update: update hys_fund_apply set status = #{status}, audit_by = #{auditBy}, audit_time = now(), audit_remark = #{auditRemark}, actual_amount = coalesce(#{actualAmount}, actual_amount) where apply_id = #{applyId} and status = 0
mapper.select: select count(1) from hys_fund_apply where status = 0
select coalesce(sum(amount), 0) from hys_fund_apply where member_id = #{memberId} and apply_type = #{applyType} and status = 1
select count(1) from hys_fund_apply where member_id = #{memberId} and apply_type = #{applyType} and status = 0
